empty.title: A new chapter starts with a map
empty.description: Open a Warcraft II map or a trigger file to begin. Your original data stays intact; every save creates a backup.
empty.detail1: Open a PUD map or a standalone trigger file.
empty.detail2: Build conditions and actions in the command sequence.
empty.detail3: Review changes and keep a backup of your original.
localHint: Your maps stay on this computer
readonly: Read only — unsupported or ambiguous data
select: Select a command to inspect its properties.
preview.title: Review your changes
preview.description: The original file is updated only when you save. A backup is created before replacement.
operation.hint: Changing the operation resets its parameters. Review the new defaults before applying.
text.encoding: Game text: Windows-1251; unsupported characters are rejected.
backups.empty: Backups become available after saving a file.
restore.confirm: Restore this backup to the file on disk? A backup of the current file will be created first. Unapplied and unsaved edits in this session will be replaced.
help.body: Open a PUD or W2TR file. Select a command, change its fields, then review and apply. Save creates a backup beside the file. Unsupported data opens read only. Changes must be checked in your War2Combat build before use in a game.
closeDirty: There are unsaved changes. Leave the editor?
